title: A clear trial changes an earlier intention

captions.energy: Clarifying what matters in plain words

meaning: A concrete example can clarify your shared intention even when the discovery requires saying farewell to an earlier expectation.
text: Even useful clarification can bring sadness for an earlier intention. The Empress in the physical position of Ajna suggests creating examples that reveal what you actually imagine. The Sun in energy supports a direct search for clarity, naming what matters without tangled guesses. Death in emotions experiences the ending of an old picture. Your shared question may become clearer while releasing an attractive expectation still feels difficult. A new explanation can be meaningful and useful before it removes the feeling of loss accompanying it.

Suppose you prepare a prompt card for discussing a book with friends. The trial questions reveal your interest in talking about personal impressions, although the original intention sounded like a detailed examination of every scene. **A clear example can name a wish while leaving room to release an earlier idea.** The gathering’s purpose becomes more understandable. You may still miss the attractive image of a thorough literary discussion. Both responses can sit together: a new meaning is available while the earlier expectation retains emotional value for you.

The difficulty is postponing a clear choice until the earlier image stops appealing altogether. You already see the difference between intentions but keep seeking an explanation that brings no sadness. Your wish for clarity retains its strength when it can name both the desire and the farewell. Understanding can then lead onwards while the experience of change is still unfolding.
